• The purposes of the processing of personal data must be clearly stated in the privacy notice [C2 (part 1)].

• When collecting data directly from the data subject, the notice must obtain a clear and unambiguous indication of consent, such as a written statement or an oral statement, as required by Article 16(1) of the GDPR [C0].
